animationProvider.name: Animations
animationProvider.hint: Automated Animations plays animations you configure in its menu (name a rule after the attack, or 'HELLPIERCERS Melee', 'HELLPIERCERS Burst Fire'...). The built-in effects need Sequencer plus a JB2A library, Free or Premium. Auto tries Automated Animations first and falls back to the built-in effects.
animationProvider.auto: Automatic: Automated Animations, then built-in JB2A

jb2aTier.name: JB2A Library
jb2aTier.hint: Which JB2A library the built-in effects use. Automatic picks Premium (Patreon) if it is active and the Free library otherwise, and every effect falls back to the best animation the installed library has.

animateAttacks.name: Animate Attacks
animateAttacks.hint: Play attack, impact and Provoke animations.

animateEffects.name: Animate Effects
animateEffects.hint: Play animations for Status Effects, healing, defeat, Rez, Limit Break and AGNOSIA. Automated Animations animates Status Effects on its own.

automateEffects.name: Automate Turn Effects
automateEffects.hint: The GM client automatically resolves Poison, Healing, Blazing, Pain Aura and effect decay at the start and end of each unit's turn.

armorRule.name: Armor Stack Rule
armorRule.flat: Rules as written: -1 damage per instance regardless of stacks

bleedRule.name: Bleed Stack Rule
bleedRule.flat: Rules as written: +1 damage per instance regardless of stacks

trackActions.name: Track Actions
trackActions.hint: Track Main, Support, Aux and Move actions for each combatant in the combat tracker.

automateProvoke.name: Automate Provoke
automateProvoke.hint: When a token is dragged away from an adjacent enemy during combat, the GM client rolls the 1D6 Provoke attack automatically. Flying (Aegis) units and forced movement never Provoke.

warTableSync.name: War Table Auto-Sync
warTableSync.hint: Keep campaign-map scenes in step with the factions: location pins, hazard circles and convoy routes update when faction data changes and when the STRATCOM phase advances.

automateTerrain.name: Automate Terrain
automateTerrain.hint: Terrain painted with the Terrain Painter resolves itself: Trapped tiles roll their damage, Linked tiles offer the step, Attractor zones offer their Pull, Cover grants -1 damage, and the Void offers instant death on forced entry. Movement is never blocked: the automation advises, the table decides.

activeParty.name: Active Party
activeParty.hint: The party whose buildings unlock items for the whole table.

deriveUnlocks.name: Unlocks From Party Buildings
deriveUnlocks.hint: Cross Class Development, Limit Breaks, Reversals and weapon slots follow the active party's buildings instead of each character's own toggles.

chatCards.name: Post Ability Cards

aggression.name: Aggression
aggression.description: Expanded Aggression Rituals: this unit's Provoke range is Range:2. Applied with 2 stacks so it lasts until the end of the unit's next turn. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit's turn.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.description: This unit may count as Flying for a number of squares of their movement up to their stacks of Aegis each turn. Flying units move over all types of terrain unimpeded, are treated as having +1 Elevation, and do not Provoke. Aegis-affected units may choose to spend their Aegis flight at any point during their movement. Aegis does not change a unit's Speed and does not count as adding spaces of movement, only modifying existing movement. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit's turn

armor.name: Armor
armor.description: This unit takes -1 damage from each instance of damage. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit's turn.

blazing.name: Blazing
blazing.description: This unit takes 1 damage at the start of each turn. Blazing spreads: any unit who begins a turn adjacent to a unit with Blazing gains Blazing:1 and im- mediately takes its 1 damage. Additional Blazing does not add to existing Blazing — keep the highest number of stacks from any one source and ignore all others. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit’s turn, but only if there are no units adjacent to it.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.description: All attacks against this target deal an additional 1 damage. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit’s turn.

bound.name: Bound
bound.description: This unit cannot inflict Effects on other creatures. Actions otherwise function as normal. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit's turn.

compel.name: Compel
compel.description: This unit forces enemies within a range equal to its stacks to attack it during their turn, if able. Compel:1 affects all units that start their turns adjacent or become adjacent and each additional stack increases the range by 1 square. Remove 1 stack after each attackagainst the affected unit.

countdown.name: Countdown
countdown.description: Countdown does nothing until the Effect ends, at which point it triggers a special effect based on the source of the Countdown. Remove 1 stack at the end of the round.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.description: This unit must attack a unit with Compel if possible, including attacking an ally. It can only take attacks that do not target a unit with Compel after making an attack that does, unless no unit has Compel. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit’s turn.

haste.name: Haste
haste.description: This unit may make one additional Action of any type during their turn. Remove 1 stack after the additional action has been taken.

healing.name: Healing
healing.description: This unit restores HP equal to their Healing value at the end of their turn. When this Effect is applied to a tile, a unit standing on it is considered to have the Effect at the tile’s number of stacks. A unit buffed with Healing:2 will restore 2 HP at the end of their turn regardless of where they move; a Healing:3 tile will then also restore 3 HP to that unit if they end their turn on that tile. These Healing Effects resolve separately if a unit is subject to both. This cannot increase a unit’s max health beyond its default max HP. Remove 1 stack from each source of healing at the end of the affected unit’s turn.

pin.name: Pin
pin.description: This unit cannot move or Sprint. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit’s turn.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: This unit takes 1 HP damage per stack at the end of their turn. After Poison’s damage is dealt, remove 1 stack of Poison.

shaded.name: Shaded
shaded.description: Creatures with Shaded:1+ are surrounded by a Burst:1 “fog of war” effect, hiding enemies and their movements from players. Players can only see enemies within a Shaded zone if they are adjacent to them. Shaded zones move with the unit or affected space unless stated otherwise. Each additional stack of Shaded increases the scale of the burst to the same number. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit's turn.

shock.name: Shock
shock.description: This unit’s actions are treated as one tier higher than their action type — Aux Actions count as Support Action, Support Actions count as Main Actions, and Main Actions are impossible. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit’s turn.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: This unit’s movement costs are doubled. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit’s turn.

transference.name: Transference
transference.description: This unit heals itself, or this attack heals the attacker, for HP equal to any damage they inflict. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit's turn.

broken.name: Broken
broken.description: All attacks against this target deal maximum damage. Remove 1 stack after each attack against the affected unit.

fortified.name: Fortified
fortified.description: When a HELLPIERCER unit begins its turn on a tile with Fortified, remove the Effect and restore 2 Reversal Charges to that unit.

pain_aura.name: Pain Aura
pain_aura.description: This unit projects a Scale:2 field around them that causes 1 damage to any units ending their turn within it, regardless of allegiance. Remove 1 stack at the end of the affected unit's turn.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.description: The affected unit cannot use Aux Actions. Hitting a Frozen target triggers Shatter, which replaces the attack's damage and effects and clears all Frozen. Ticks down at the end of the affected unit's turn.

wound.name: Wound
wound.description: A mark of CAIM's vengeance. Wounds do not tick down and last until the TACCOM encounter is over or a Metricos ability spends them. Whenever a Metricos unit applies an Effect it also applies Wound:1.

wrack.name: Wrack
wrack.description: The next attack against this unit cannot roll any damage die lower than its Wrack value (never above the die's maximum), then all Wrack is cleared.

constrict.name: Constrict
constrict.description: This unit may not move on their turn, and takes additional damage from all sources equal to its Constrict stacks.

brand.name: Brand
brand.description: When the Brand reaches 0, the Branded creature or object explodes, dealing 4D6 damage to the target and 6 damage to all adjacent targets. Remove 1 stack at the end of the round.

retaliation.name: Retaliation
retaliation.description: Gained when attacked while in a riposte stance. Spend stacks to empower your next counter-charge. Lose 1 stack when you end a turn outside the stance.

retrieve.name: Retrieve
retrieve.description: When this unit is attacked it may spend 1 stack to move adjacent to its anchor, or move the anchor adjacent to itself.

rush.name: Rush
rush.description: Spend a stack as a Free action to double your Speed at any time during your turn.

magnetic.name: Magnetic
magnetic.description: At the start of the affected unit's turn, creatures linked to it move 2 spaces toward it. This is not regular movement and costs no Speed, but still Provokes.

snakeskin.name: Snakeskin
snakeskin.description: The unit takes 0 damage from the next attack targeting it, then loses Snakeskin.

glassflesh.name: Glassflesh
glassflesh.description: The target receives double damage from the next attack targeting them. The status lingers on the space where a unit dies and is picked up by the next enemy to enter it.

agnosia.name: Agnosia
agnosia.description: This unit has reached its Agnosia threshold and may use its single-use Agnosia move.
